package practiceroute

import (
	"context"
	"testing"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	domainservice "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain/service"
)

func TestEnsureMaterialLazilyCreatesOneReusableCourseLesson(t *testing.T) {
	routes := newRouteRepositoryStub()
	catalog := &practiceCatalogStub{definitions: []domain.LearningTargetDefinition{
		{Ref: targetDOM, Title: "DOM events", Description: "Handle browser events"},
		{Ref: targetCSS, Title: "CSS Grid", Description: "Build grid layouts", Prerequisites: []domain.TargetRef{targetDOM}},
	}}
	resolver := testResolver(routes, catalog, &practiceStudentStub{mastery: []domain.TargetMastery{
		{Target: targetDOM, State: domain.MasteryMastered, MasteryScore: 1, Confidence: 1, PolicyVersion: domain.StudentMasteryPolicyVersion},
		{Target: targetCSS, State: domain.MasteryUnknown, PolicyVersion: domain.StudentMasteryPolicyVersion},
	}})
	route, _, err := resolver.Resolve(context.Background(), validRouteRequest().TaskInstanceID, validRouteRequest())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	material := route.Steps[0].Requirements[1].Material
	if material == nil {
		t.Fatal("adaptive gap has no material identity")
	}
	generator := &materialGeneratorStub{}
	courses := &materialCourseStub{}
	materializer := Materializer{Routes: routes, Catalog: catalog, Generator: generator, Courses: courses}
	request := domain.PracticeMaterialEnsureRequestV1{Schema: domain.PracticeMaterialEnsureRequestSchemaV1, RouteID: route.ID, RouteDigest: route.RouteDigest}
	result, err := materializer.Ensure(context.Background(), material.GenerationKey, material.Key, request)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("ensure: %v", err)
	}
	if result.Schema != domain.PracticeMaterialResultSchemaV1 || result.MaterialKey != material.Key || result.LessonID == "" {
		t.Fatalf("result=%+v", result)
	}
	if generator.calls != 1 || courses.calls != 1 || courses.idempotencyKey != material.GenerationKey {
		t.Fatalf("generator_calls=%d course_calls=%d key=%q", generator.calls, courses.calls, courses.idempotencyKey)
	}
	firstGenerationKey := generator.lastKey
	lesson := courses.course.Modules[0].Sections[0].Lessons[0]
	if courses.course.Status != domain.CourseStatusActive || courses.course.Fingerprint != material.Key ||
		len(lesson.Targets) != 1 || domain.TargetIdentity(lesson.Targets[0]) != domain.TargetIdentity(targetCSS) ||
		len(lesson.Prerequisites) != 1 || lesson.Status != domain.LessonStatusActive {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected lazy course: %+v", courses.course)
	}

	_, err = materializer.Ensure(context.Background(), material.GenerationKey, material.Key, request)
	if err != nil || generator.lastKey != firstGenerationKey || courses.idempotencyKey != material.GenerationKey {
		t.Fatalf("retry identities drifted: generator=%q course=%q err=%v", generator.lastKey, courses.idempotencyKey, err)
	}
}

type materialGeneratorStub struct {
	calls   int
	lastKey string
}

func (stub *materialGeneratorStub) GenerateLesson(_ context.Context, _ domainservice.LessonGenerationInput, key string) (domainservice.GeneratedLessonContent, error) {
	stub.calls++
	stub.lastKey = key
	return domainservice.GeneratedLessonContent{
		DescriptionMarkdown: "Изучи CSS Grid перед шагом.",
		Examples:            []domain.PlannedExample{{Title: "Grid", DescriptionMarkdown: "Пример сетки", Stacks: []string{"css"}, TargetConcepts: []string{"css.grid"}}},
		KnowledgeChecks:     []domain.PlannedTask{{Title: "Проверка", DescriptionMarkdown: "Что делает grid?", ExpectedAnswers: []string{"Создаёт сетку"}}},
	}, nil
}

type materialCourseStub struct {
	calls          int
	idempotencyKey string
	course         domain.GeneratedCourse
}

func (stub *materialCourseStub) EnsureCourse(_ context.Context, course domain.GeneratedCourse, key string) (domain.EnsureCourseResult, error) {
	stub.calls++
	stub.idempotencyKey = key
	stub.course = course
	return domain.EnsureCourseResult{CourseID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", Reused: stub.calls > 1, Lessons: []domain.CourseLessonBinding{{LessonID: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555", Order: 0, Targets: []domain.TargetRef{targetCSS}}}}, nil
}
